update_text: Blood Moon is here: new battle pass rewards that survive Rebirth.
title: BLOOD MOON
message: Season 1 battle pass got a rework! Tier 30 premium now gives Blood Moon skins for 5 heroes plus the Blood Moon Sigil (+10% Souls forever). Premium rewards are now Souls, Shards and skins, so nothing gets wiped when you Rebirth. Thanks for playing!
